blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Real desktop automation is neither purely visual nor purely programmatic. Agents must understand user-facing interfaces while efficiently manipulating files, scripts, and system state. However, native GUI/code coordination cannot be obtained by prompt-level tool composition. In our preliminary experiments, naively adding a code tool degrades a GUI agent, revealing that GUI/code routing must be internalized through training on high-quality hybrid data. We present OS-Helix, an end-to-end trained multimodal computer-using agent that unifies GUI actions and code execution in one action space. To construct the required supervision, we introduce application-artifact composition, pairing desktop applications with authentic file artifacts to instantiate executable Ubuntu states, and a decoupled instruction/evaluator generation pipeline that produces environment-grounded tasks whose final states can be verified regardless of the solution modality. We cold-start the policy with SFT on filtered hybrid data and further improve it through online RL in live desktop environments. For RL, we propose Step-balanced GSPO, which aggregates importance weight by action step rather than raw assistant tokens to prevent long code actions from dominating heterogeneous-action optimization. On OSWorld-Verified, OS-Helix-27B and OS-Helix-35B-A3B achieve relative improvements of 35.0% and 33.7% over their matched Qwen3.5 hybrid baselines, while OS-Helix-27B-RL further improves by 42.9% to reach 66.44% success. Ablations provide evidence consistent with contributions from learned GUI/code coordination, scalable verifiable supervision, and action step balanced optimization, while demonstrating cross-platform transfer on WindowsAgentArena. Our project homepage is at https://os-copilot.github.io/OS-Helix/.
blocks.zh: 真正的桌面自动化既不纯粹是视觉的,也不是纯粹的程序性的. 代理必须了解用户界面,同时高效地操纵文件,脚本和系统状态. 然而,本地的GUI/代码协调无法通过即时级工具组成来获得. 在我们的初步实验中,天真地添加一个代码工具会降解一个GUI代理,揭示出GUI/代码的路由必须通过高质量的混合数据培训进行内化. 我们介绍OS-Helix,这是经过端到端训练的多式计算机使用代理,统一了GUI在一个行动空间中的动作和代码执行. 为了构建所需的监督,我们引入了应用艺术成分,将桌面应用程序与真实的文件文物配对,以即时化可执行的Ubuntu状态,以及解相接的指令/评估器生成管道,以产生基于环境的任务,其最终状态无论溶液模式如何都可以核实。 我们用SFT冷却地启动过滤后混合数据的政策,并通过在线RL在活的桌面环境中进一步改进. 就RL而言,我们提议采用分步平衡的普惠制,通过行动步骤而不是原始的辅助标志来汇总重要性,以防止较长的代码动作占据不同动作优化的主导地位。 在OSWorld-Verification上,OS-Helix-27B和OS-Helix-35B-A3B比相匹配的Quen3.5混合基线实现相对改善35.0%和33.7%,而OS-Helix-27B-RL则进一步提高了42.9%,达到了66.44%的成功率. 校正提供了与所学GUI/代码协调,可扩展可核查监督,以及动作步骤平衡优化等贡献相一致的证据,同时在WindowsAgentArena上演示了跨平台的传输. 我们的项目主页是https://os-copilot.github.io/OS-Helix/。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of GUI-only, code-only, and hybrid computer use.
blocks.zh: 图1:仅限GUI,只限代码,和混合计算机使用概况.

blocks.en: The rapid progress of vision-language models (VLMs) ( Team, 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Team et al., 2026a ; Anthropic, 2025b ; Zeng et al., 2026 ; OpenAI, 2025 ; Bai et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2026 ) has accelerated the development of computer-using agents (CUAs), which aim to execute open-ended tasks in human-facing digital environments. Most existing CUAs formulate digital automation as graphical interaction, where agents perceive screenshots, reason over interface states, and act through mouse and keyboard operations.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)(Team, 2026;Wang等, 2025b;Team等, 2026a;Anthropic, 2025b;Zeng等, 2026;OpenAI, 2025;Bai等, 2026;Zou等, 2026)的快速进步,加速了计算机使用剂(CUAs)的开发,目的是在人造数字环境中执行开放式任务. 大多数已存在的 CUA 将数字自动化开发为图形交互,其中代理人员能感知截图,理性超过界面状态,并通过鼠标和键盘操作来行动.

blocks.en:
However, GUI-centric CUAs ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Xue et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2024 ; Feizi et al., 2026 ) still face practical bottlenecks in realistic desktop workflows.
Visual grounding can fail on small or ambiguous interface elements, and fine-grained interaction can make structured state manipulation cumbersome even with batched actions.
A complementary interface is programmatic control, through which command-line and code agents can inspect files, access system state, and execute compound operations directly through the shell ( Yang et al., 2026e ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025c ) .
Yet code execution alone cannot fully address the long tail of desktop task scenarios that depends on visual layout, application-specific UI state, or software behavior exposed only through the interface. As illustrated in Figure 1 , these complementary strengths motivate a single agent that coordinates GUI and code, where GUI provides general visual access to arbitrary applications while code provides efficient and precise manipulation of programmatic state.
blocks.zh:
然而,以图形用户界面为中心的 CUAAs(刘等,2026;薛等,2026;王等,2026b;张等,2026a;罗等,2025;程等,2024;费济等,2026)在现实桌面工作流程中仍然面临实际瓶颈.
视觉地平面在小的或模棱两可的界面元素上会失败,精细的相互作用甚至会使结构化的状态操纵变得累赘,即使有分批动作.
互补接口是程序控制,命令行和代码代理可以通过程序控制检查文件,访问系统状态,直接通过外壳执行复合操作(Yang等,2026e; 杨等,2024;王等,2025c.).
然而,仅凭代码执行无法完全解决依赖于视觉布局,应用程序特定UI状态,或软件行为仅通过界面被曝光的桌面任务情景的长尾. 如图1所显示的,这些互补的优势激励着一个单一的代理,协调GUI和代码,GUI提供任意应用的一般可视访问,而代码则提供高效和精确地操纵程序状态.

blocks.en:
Despite this complementarity, building a native hybrid GUI/code CUA remains an open problem. Simply attaching a code tool to a GUI model does not teach it when or why to use either modality. In our preliminary experiments, as shown in Table 14 , Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) achieves over ∼ \sim 34% success on OSWorld-Verified ( Xie et al., 2025 ) with GUI actions alone, but falls to roughly ∼ \sim 32% when code execution is naively exposed.
Prompt-level composition can therefore disrupt an existing GUI policy rather than create coordinated behavior, making it essential to internalize hybrid coordination capabilities into the model through training on high-quality hybrid data.
Several existing approaches have explored hybrid execution paradigms that combine GUI interaction with code-like actions. Framework-centric systems ( Gonzalez-Pumariega et al., 2025 ; Hou et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) rely on external harnesses to coordinate GUI, code, memory, and recovery; tool-call-based approaches ( Jia et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Shi et al., 2026 ) expose programmatic operations through predefined application-specific interfaces; and model-fusion approaches ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Qin et al., 2025 ) combine complementary capabilities through predefined designs.
Although these systems expand the scope of hybrid computer use, they leave open how a single policy can learn the routing between the GUI and code actions through hybrid training.
blocks.zh:
尽管存在这种互补性,建立本地混合图形用户界面/代码CUA仍然是一个尚未解决的问题. 简单地将一个代码工具附加到图形界面模型中并不教它何时或为什么使用任一模式。 如表14所示,在我们的初步实验中,Qune3-VL-32B-Instructionct(Bai等,2025年)在OSWorld-Verification(Xie等,2025年)上取得了34%以上的成功,单是GUI行动,但当代码执行被天真地曝光时,则降到了大约 \\ sim 32%。
因此,即时层次的构成会打乱现有的GUI政策,而不是产生协调的行为,因此,必须通过高质量的混合数据培训,将混合协调能力内部化入模型。
一些现有方法探索了混合执行模式,将GUI互动与类似代码的行动相结合. 以框架为中心的系统(Gonzalez-Pumariega等人,2025年;Hou等人,2024年;Yang等人,2026年a)依靠外部手段协调GUI、代码、记忆和恢复;基于工具的调用方法(Jia等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年b;Shi等人,2026年b)通过预先界定的具体应用界面暴露出方案运作;以及模型集成方法(Wang等人,2025年a; 秦等,"2025")通过预先定义的设计,将互补能力结合起来.
虽然这些系统扩展了混合计算机的使用范围,但是它们留下了单一政策如何通过混合训练来学习GUI和代码动作之间的路由.

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we present OS-Helix, an end-to-end trained computer-using agent that unifies GUI interaction and code execution within a single policy.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出了OS-Helix,这是经过端到端训练的计算机使用代理,统一了GUI在单一政策范围内的互动和代码执行.

blocks.en: On the infrastructure side, we introduce application–artifact composition, which combines versioned applications with authentic artifacts to instantiate diverse and reproducible desktop states. An Exploration Agent proposes instructions grounded in these states through brief exploration of the initialized environment, while an independent Evaluator Agent constructs task-specific, primarily rule-based evaluators. Together, this pipeline supports scalable synthesis, filtering, and collection of high-quality GUI/code trajectories for model training, thereby providing the data foundation necessary to internalize hybrid coordination capabilities into the model.
blocks.zh: 在基础设施方面,我们引入了应用-艺术成分,将已版本的应用与正版的工艺品结合起来,以即时化地开发出多种可复制的桌面状态。 勘探代理人通过对初始化环境的简短探索,提出基于这些状态的指令,而独立的评估代理人则构筑出具体的任务,主要是基于规则的评估人员. 这个管道一起支持可伸缩的合成,过滤,以及收集高质量的GUI/代码轨迹,用于模型培训,从而为将混合协调能力内部化入模型提供必要的数据基础.

blocks.en:
On the training side, we first use filtered hybrid trajectories to internalize basic action semantics and modality routing, and then optimize the policy through online RL in executable desktop environments.
In early RL experiments, we observe a steady increase in the proportion of code actions accompanied by a degradation in performance. We attribute this to the token-count asymmetry between short GUI actions and substantially longer code actions, which causes the optimization signal to be dominated by code steps.
To address this, we propose Step-balanced GSPO , which constructs the sample-level importance ratio over action steps rather than raw assistant-token counts, enabling more balanced optimization of the two modalities.
These training components directly answer the open question of how a single policy can natively learn to coordinate GUI and code actions through hybrid training, yielding an agent that performs strongly and reliably across diverse desktop tasks.
blocks.zh:
在训练方面,我们首先使用被过滤的混合轨迹来内部化基本动作语义和模式路由,再通过在线RL在可执行桌面环境中优化政策.
在早期的RL实验中,我们看到了代码动作比例的稳步上升并伴随着性能的退化. 我们将此归因于短的GUI动作和长得多的代码动作之间的符号-count不对称,这导致优化信号被代码步骤所主导.
为了解决这个问题,我们建议采用步调平衡的普惠制,它构建了与行动步骤相比的抽样重要性比率,而不是原始的助理计算,从而能够更平衡地优化这两种模式。
这些培训内容直接回答了一个尚未解决的问题,即单一政策如何通过混合培训在本土学习协调GUI和代码行动,从而产生一种能够强有力和可靠地完成不同桌面任务的代理。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: 1) We formulate native GUI/code hybrid computer use as an end-to-end policy-learning problem and show through controlled experiments that merely exposing a GUI policy to code execution fails to yield reliable routing, motivating the need to internalize coordination through hybrid training.
blocks.zh: 1) 我们将本地的GUI/代码混合计算机作为端到端的政策学习问题,并通过控制实验显示,仅仅让GUI政策执行代码不能产生可靠的路由,促使需要通过混合培训将协调内部化。

blocks.en: 2) We introduce application–artifact composition and a decoupled instruction/evaluator synthesis pipeline to construct diverse, reproducible, executable desktop states and generate high-quality hybrid data for internalizing GUI and code execution capabilities.
blocks.zh: (2) 我们引入了应用-艺术成分和解相接的指令/评估器合成管道,以构建多样化、可再生产、可执行的桌面状态并生成高质量的混合数据,使GUI和代码执行能力内部化。

blocks.en: 3) We propose Step-balanced GSPO for the agentic RL stage of native hybrid policy training, which prevents long code actions from dominating optimization, and enables a single policy to learn GUI and code coordination.
blocks.zh: 3) 我们提议对本地混合政策培训的代理RL阶段实行分步平衡的普惠制,这妨碍了长期代码行动主导优化,并使单一政策能够学习GUI和代码协调。

blocks.en: 4) We will release the OS-Helix model family and research artifacts, including the desktop data-synthesis and RL environments, task and trajectory collection pipelines, approximately 9K generated instructions, 83K unfiltered SFT samples, and about 31K successful filtered SFT samples in the unified GUI/code action space.
blocks.zh: 4)我们将发布OS-Helix模型家族和研究文物,包括桌面数据合成和RL环境,任务和轨迹收集管道,约9K生成指令,83K未过滤的SFT样本,以及约31K在统一的GUI/代码行动空间中被过滤成功的SFT样本.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Hybrid GUI/Code Computer-Using Agents. Traditional GUI-native agents learn screenshot-to-action policies over visual interface states ( Qin et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025d ) , whereas command-line and coding agents operate over files, shells, and programmatic state ( Anthropic, 2025a ; OpenClaw, 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . Their complementary strengths motivate hybrid computer use.
Framework-centric systems ( Gonzalez-Pumariega et al., 2025 ; Hou et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) coordinate GUI, code, memory, and recovery through external harnesses, often using strong proprietary models. Their performance is coupled to costly inference and hand-engineered orchestration, making the model’s own hybrid coordination difficult to isolate. Tool-call-based approaches ( Jia et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Shi et al., 2026 ) expose programmatic operations through predefined, application-specific interfaces, limiting coverage and transfer to available integrations and tool schemas. Some approaches integrate GUI, code, and other capabilities through model fusion ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Qin et al., 2025 ) , relying on predefined fusion rather than coordination learned within a single policy.
Qwen-UI-Agent ( Zhou et al., 2026a ) also explores training with mixed GUI and code-like action capabilities, demonstrating the practical potential of native hybrid agents.
However, existing studies describe data construction, executable environments, supervision, and training configurations at different levels of granularity, making controlled reproduction and comparison of learned coordination mechanisms difficult.
Our work complements by studying executable application–artifact state construction, decoupled instruction–evaluator synthesis, and more stable optimization for training a single GUI/code policy.
blocks.zh:
混合图形用户界面/代码计算机使用代理。 传统的GUI-内幕代理在视觉界面状态上学习截图对行动政策(秦等,2025;王等,2026b;吴等,2025;刘等,2026;王等,2025d;而指挥线和编码代理在文件,贝壳和方案状态上运行(Anthropic,2025a;OpenClaw,2026;杨等,2026b;杨等,2024.). 它们的互补优势促使混合计算机的使用。
以框架为中心的系统(Gonzalez-Pumariega等人,2025年;Hou等人,2025年) 2024; Yang等, 2026a)通过外接来协调GUI,代码,内存和复苏,经常使用强大的专有模式. 它们的性能与昂贵的推论和手工设计的管弦乐相结合,使得模型本身的混合协调难以分离. 基于工具的调用方法(Jia等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年b;Shi等人,2026年b)通过预先界定的、具体应用的接口,限制覆盖面和向现有集成和工具计划转让,暴露了方案业务。 一些方法通过模型聚变整合了GUI、代码和其他能力(Wang等人,2025a; 秦等,"2025"),依靠预先定义的聚变,而不是在单一政策中吸取的协调.
Quen-UI-Agent (Zhou et al., 2026a) 也探索使用混合GUI和类似代码的动作能力进行训练,展示了本土杂交剂的实际潜力.
然而,现有的研究描述了数据构建,可执行环境,监管,以及不同颗粒度的训练配置,使得对所学协调机制的控制复制和比较变得很困难.
我们的工作通过研究可执行的应用 — — 艺术状态构建,解开指令 — — 评价者综合,以及更稳定的优化培训单一的图形用户界面/代码政策来补充我们的工作。

blocks.en:
Environment Scaling and Task Synthesis for Computer-Using Agents. Realistic long-horizon tasks and interactive environments are essential for training CUAs, yet manual task design and trajectory annotation are expensive and difficult to scale. This makes automated acquisition of high-quality instructions and demonstrations a central problem. One line of work crawls web tutorials and documentation and decomposes them into executable task instructions ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Another line starts from the target environment itself and infers tasks from what the agent can observe or manipulate: Explorer ( Pahuja et al., 2025 ) extracts and refines task intents from web entry pages, while OS-Genesis ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , GUI-ReWalk ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , TreeCUA ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) , and AUTO PLAY ( Ramrakhya et al., 2026 ) synthesize tasks through exploratory interaction with the environment. These methods primarily scale task and trajectory synthesis, but they do not substantially scale the underlying interactive worlds, which constrains the diversity of behaviors learned by the agent.
Unlike more constrained interaction domains such as web and mobile ( Cao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026b ; Cheng et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026 ) , PC environments, such as Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS, provide a natural substrate for scalable CUA training through system-level code execution, mature application ecosystems, persistent file systems, and package managers, enabling verifiable tasks grounded in concrete system state ( Sun et al., 2026a ; Fu et al., 2026 ) . Recent work has begun to use virtual machines to expand desktop environments and synthesize tasks ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Lv et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) , exploring different parts of desktop-state construction and task generation. Table 6 summarizes the reported coverage of existing task-synthesis pipelines. Existing efforts differ in the extent to which they scale applications, authentic artifacts, executable initial states, and verifiable terminal conditions.
Our pipeline integrates application–artifact composition, reproducible desktop-state construction, and environment-grounded instruction and evaluator synthesis into a unified framework for scalable, verifiable desktop-task generation.
blocks.zh:
计算机用户代理的扩展环境和任务合成。 现实的长视距任务和互动环境对培训海关总署至关重要,但人工任务设计和轨迹说明费用昂贵,难以衡量。 这使得对高质量指令和演示的自动获取成为一个核心问题. 一行活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活 另一行从目标环境本身开始,并推断出代理人能够观察到或操纵哪些任务:探索者(Pahuja等,2025年)从网页条目取出并完善任务意图,而OS-Genesis(Sun等,2025年),GUI-ReWalk(Lin等,2025年),TreeCUA (Jiang等,2026年),和AUTO PLAY(Ramrakhya等,2026年)通过探索性与环境的相互作用来合成任务. 这些方法主要衡量任务和轨迹合成,但它们并没有实质上衡量潜在的交互世界,这制约了代理人所学到的行为的多样性.
与网络和移动等较为受限的互动领域不同(Cao等,2026;Zhang等,2026c;Wu等,2026;Tang等,2026b;Cheng等,2026;Yan等,2026),PC环境,如Ubuntu、Windows和macOS,通过系统一级代码执行、成熟的应用生态系统、持久性文件系统以及包管理器,为可扩展的CUA培训提供了一个天然的底板,使基于具体系统状态的可核查任务成为可能(Sun等,2026a; Fu等, 2026 (英语). 最近的工作已经开始使用虚拟机来扩展桌面环境和合成任务(Wang等,2026a; Lv等,2026; Huang等,2026),探索桌面-状态建设和任务生成的不同部分. 表6汇总了所报告的现有任务综合管道的覆盖范围。 现有努力在应用规模、真实文物、可执行初始状态和可核查的终端条件方面各不相同。
我们的管道将应用-艺术构成、可再生的桌面状态构建、以及基于环境的指令和评价者综合纳入可扩展、可核查的桌面任务生成的统一框架。

blocks.en:
Training Paradigms for Computer-Using Agents. CUA training has broadly evolved from imitation-style supervised fine-tuning toward reinforcement learning in interactive environments. SFT-based systems learn action formats, visual grounding, and task execution from human demonstrations, synthetic trajectories, web tutorials, or teacher-model rollouts ( Cheng et al., 2024 ; Qin et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . Between SFT and online interaction, offline preference-optimization methods such as DPO ( Gao et al., 2026 ) and offline GRPO ( Yang et al., 2026c ) improve policies from static preference data, but remain limited by the coverage of collected trajectories and cannot directly optimize recovery under environment feedback. Online RL methods for CUAs are further split into grounding RL and agentic RL. Grounding RL optimizes low-level GUI localization or action selection with specialized visual rewards ( Lu et al., 2026b ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026b ; Tang et al., 2026a ; Feizi et al., 2026 ) . Agentic RL instead optimizes complete trajectories in executable environments with rule-based or verifiable rewards. Recent CUA work has begun to tailor the optimization algorithm to this setting: ComputerRL ( Lai et al., 2026 ) introduces Entropulse, which alternates online RL with SFT to mitigate entropy collapse; CUA-Gym ( Wang et al., 2026a ) trains CUA checkpoints with GSPO ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) ; and ScaleCUA ( Lv et al., 2026 ) adopts GRPO-style RL ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) together with frontier sampling and visual-context segmentation. EvoCUA-1.5 ( Huang et al., 2026 ) proposes Step-Level Policy Optimization for decomposed multi-turn samples.
Nevertheless, how to systematically train a single policy to route between native GUI and code actions while maintaining stable optimization across heterogeneous action granularities remains underexplored.
Our work addresses this setting through hybrid SFT and online agentic RL with Step-balanced GSPO, mitigating optimization imbalance and enabling more effective native coordination.
blocks.zh:
计算机用户培训范式。 CUA培训从模仿式的有监督的微调发展到互动环境中的强化学习。 基于SFT的系统从人类的演示,合成轨迹,网络教程,或师范模式的推出中学习动作格式,可视化定位,任务执行(成等,2024;秦等,2025;王等,2026b;张等,2026a;孙等,2025;刘等,2026). 在SFT与在线互动之间,由DPO(Gao等,2026年)和GRPO(Yang等,2026年c)等离线偏好优化方法改进了从静态偏好数据中获取的政策,但依然受到所收集轨迹覆盖的限制,无法在环境反馈下直接优化恢复. CUA的在线RL方法被进一步分为地基RL和代理RL. 定位RL优化了低水平的图形界面本地化或动作选择,并有专门的视觉奖励(Lu等,2026b;Yuan等,2025;Zhou等,2026b;Tang等,2026a;Feizi等,2026). 相反,代理RL在可执行环境中优化了完整的轨迹,并有基于规则或可核查的奖励. 最近的CUA工作已经开始使优化算法适应此设置: ComputerRL(Lai等,2026年)引入 Entropulse, 将在线RL与SFT相替代来缓解 en倒塌; CUA-Gym (Wang等, 2026a) 使用普惠制O(Zheng等, 2025年) 培训CUA检查站;以及 ScaleCUA (Lv等, 2026年) 采用GRPO风格的RL(Shao等, 2024年;Yu等, 2026年),同时进行边界取样和视觉文字分解. EvoCUA-1.5 (Huang等,2026年)提出分解多转子样品的分步级政策优化.
然而,如何系统地培训单一政策,在本土的图形用户界面和代码行动之间取向,同时保持不同行动颗粒之间的稳定优化,仍然没有得到充分利用。
我们的工作是通过混合式SFT和在线代理RL与步调平衡的普惠制O处理这一设置,缓解优化不平衡,并促成更有效的本土协调。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the OS-Helix pipeline. Stage 1 constructs executable desktop environments by composing applications and artifacts. Stage 2 explores each environment to synthesize instructions and evaluators, yielding verifiable tasks. Stage 3 uses teacher-generated GUI/code trajectories for SFT cold start. Stage 4 performs online agentic RL in live sandboxes.
blocks.zh: 图 2:OS-Helix管道概况. 第1阶段通过编组应用程序和文物来构建可执行的桌面环境. 第二阶段探索每一种环境,以综合指令和评价者,产生可核查的任务. 第3阶段使用由老师生成的GUI/代码轨迹来进行SFT冷起步. 第四阶段在活沙盒中进行在线代理RL.

blocks.en: 3 OS-Helix
blocks.zh: 3个OS-Helix

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en: An overview of the OS-Helix pipeline is shown in Figure 2 . OS-Helix is built around a simple premise: a real computer-using agent should treat GUI interaction and code execution as two complementary ways of changing the same digital state. Rather than attaching a shell tool to a GUI model at inference time, we construct a unified pipeline in which environments, instructions, trajectories, and reinforcement signals are all designed for hybrid GUI/code execution.
blocks.zh: OS-Helix管道概况见图2。 OS-Helix是围绕一个简单的前提构建的:一个真正的计算机使用代理应该将GUI交互和代码执行作为改变同一个数字状态的两个互补方式. 与其在推断时间将外壳工具附加在图形用户界面模型上,不如构建一个统一的管道,其中环境、指令、轨迹和加固信号都用于混合图形用户界面/代码执行。

blocks.en:
Formally, let q q denote the user instruction, h i h_{i} the history context before step i i , and o i o_{i} the current screen observation. The policy selects an action from a unified hybrid action space: a i ∼ π θ ( ⋅ ∣ q , h i , o i ) , a i ∈ 𝒜 hybrid = 𝒜 GUI ∪ 𝒜 meta ⏟ 𝒜 native ∪ 𝒜 code . a_{i}\sim\pi_{\theta}(\cdot\mid q,h_{i},o_{i}),\qquad a_{i}\in\mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{hybrid}}=\underbrace{\mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{GUI}}\cup\mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{meta}}}_{\mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{native}}}\cup\mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{code}}. Here, 𝒜 GUI \mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{GUI}} denotes GUI actions such as clicking and typing; 𝒜 meta \mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{meta}} denotes episode-level meta-actions such as task termination; actions in 𝒜 code \mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{code}} execute either Python or Bash directly in the operating system.
Each code action runs in a fresh process. Its stdout and stderr are appended to the current-turn context as a tool response for subsequent decision-making.

每个代码动作都在一个新的过程中运行. 其Studout和stder被附在了当前转向上下文中,作为后续决策的工具响应.

blocks.en: 3.2 Data Infrastructure
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 数据基础设施

blocks.en: The scale of computer-using agent training is ultimately bounded by the diversity of executable states from which meaningful tasks can arise. This is particularly important on desktops, where workflows are shaped jointly by applications, user artifacts, and persistent local state. We view authentic artifacts as a natural axis for expanding this state space, with artifact types and file formats providing a direct link to the applications that can operate on them. Based on this principle, we construct diverse executable desktop environments and synthesize grounded, verifiable tasks from the resulting states.
blocks.zh: 计算机使用剂培训的规模最终取决于可执行状态的多样性,由此可以产生有意义的任务。 这在桌面上特别重要,因为工作流程是由应用程序,用户文物,以及持续的本地状态共同塑造的. 我们认为正宗的文物是扩大这种状态空间的自然轴心,其文物类型和文件格式可直接与可以在其上操作的应用程序相连接. 基于这一原则,我们构建了多种多样的可执行桌面环境,并从由此产生的状态综合了有根据的,可核查的任务.

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Application–Artifact Composition for Desktop Environments
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 桌面环境的应用 - 艺术构成

blocks.en: Real-world desktop workflows are commonly grounded in existing artifacts that are read, edited, or transformed through applications. Thus, we factor scalable desktop-environment construction into two reusable components: applications with fixed versions, launch procedures, and diverse initialization configurations, and artifacts carrying authentic content and persistent state. Their compatibility-aware composition produces executable desktop states from which realistic tasks can arise.
blocks.zh: 现实世界的桌面工作流程通常以通过应用程序来读取,编辑或转换出的现有文物为基础. 因此,我们把可扩展的桌面-环境建设分为两个可再利用组件:具有固定版本的应用程序、发射程序、不同的初始化配置以及具有真实内容和持久性状态的文物。 它们的相容感-感知构成产生了可执行的桌面状态,从中可以产生现实的任务.

blocks.en: To instantiate such states at scale, we organize artifacts and applications into an application–artifact compatibility graph , whose edges are determined by the artifact types and file formats that applications can consume. The underlying application configuration records these supported input types, together with the version, launch commands, and initialization settings required for reproducible execution. For example, a .pptx artifact can be connected to LibreOffice Impress and WPS Presentation directly, whose application configurations specify how each application is launched with the file and which application-specific initialization settings are required. The resulting states are instantiated on reproducible Ubuntu virtual machines for task synthesis and trajectory collection.
blocks.zh: 为了大规模地将此类状态迅速化,我们将文物和应用程序组织成一个应用程序 — — 艺术相容图,其边缘由应用程序可以消耗的文物类型和文件格式决定。 基本的应用程序配置记录这些支持的输入类型,连同版本,发射命令,以及再生执行所需的初始化设置. 例如,一个.pptx文物可以直接连接到LibreOffice Impress和WPS演示,其应用程序配置具体规定了每个应用程序如何随文件一起启动,以及需要哪些应用程序特定的初始化设置. 由此产生的状态在可复制的Ubuntu虚拟机上被即时化,用于任务合成和轨迹收集.

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Environment-Grounded Task Synthesis
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 环球任务综述

blocks.en: Given the diverse desktop environments constructed above, we next translate environment diversity into training-task diversity. Each synthesis episode first samples a target application and then selects compatible artifacts via the application–artifact compatibility graph , thereby instantiating a coherent and executable task context.
blocks.zh: 鉴于上面构建的桌面环境多种多样,我们接下来将环境多样性转化为培训任务多样性。 每集合成首先取出一个目标应用的样本,然后通过应用程序——相容相容相容图来选择相容的文物,从而即时地勾出一个连贯而可执行的任务上下文.

blocks.en: Relying primarily on model priors tends to produce generic, repetitive instruction patterns and underutilize the state diversity of instantiated environments at scale. We therefore ground instruction generation in active exploration of the current environment. To avoid repeatedly covering familiar functionality, we maintain a global application memory that records functions previously exercised for each application and exposes this history during subsequent exploration, encouraging broader coverage over time. The Exploration Agent receives this memory together with application metadata, exact file paths, launch configuration, tutorial, and initial screenshot, and performs a short non-destructive exploration restricted to opening, clicking, scrolling, and terminating. Based on the observed artifact content and application state, it proposes a realistic user instruction together with its initialization configuration and observable success conditions, without prescribing a GUI/code solution or revealing answer-critical information.
blocks.zh: 主要依靠模型前传往往产生通用的,重复的指令模式,并没有充分利用规模化的即时环境的状态多样性. 因此,我们在积极探索当前环境方面进行地面教学。 为避免反复覆盖所熟悉的功能,我们维持一个全球应用程序内存,记录以前为每个应用程序行使的功能,并在以后的探索中揭露这一历史,鼓励随着时间推移扩大覆盖面. 探索代理公司收到这个内存以及应用程序元数据、精确的文件路径、发射配置、教程和初始截图,并进行一个简短的无损探索,仅限于打开、点击、滚动和终止。 根据所观测到的文物内容和应用状态,它提出了一个现实的用户指导及其初始化配置和可观察到的成功条件,而没有规定GUI/代码解决方案或披露解答关键信息.

blocks.en: To make synthesized tasks consistently verifiable, we adopt an everything-is-a-file abstraction in which terminal conditions are mapped, whenever possible, to inspectable file representations, and evaluator synthesis selects rule-based, VLM-based, or hybrid checks according to their observability. Verification specifies the desired terminal state without constraining how it is reached, allowing the same task to be completed through GUI interaction, code execution, or their combination.
blocks.zh: 为了使综合任务能够持续地可核查,我们采用了一种“万事俱备”的抽象方法,尽可能地绘制终端条件图,以检查文件说明,评估者综合根据其可观察性选择基于规则的、基于VLM的或混合的检查。 校验指定想要的终端状态而不限制它是如何达到的,允许通过GUI交互,代码执行,或者它们的组合来完成同样的任务.

blocks.en:
We decouple the instruction proposal from evaluator synthesis. Once an instruction proposal is accepted, its instruction and success conditions are frozen and passed to an independent Evaluator Agent , which compiles the corresponding verification logic. Programmatically observable conditions are evaluated primarily with rule-based checks over VM files and command-line state, while visual conditions that cannot be reliably recovered programmatically are handled with VLM-based evaluation.
Instructions and evaluators are validated separately in the pipeline. Instructions are checked for reachability, unambiguity, realism, and sufficient verification conditions, while evaluators must compile and assign zero reward to the initial state. Invalid evaluators are repaired when possible. Each validated instruction and evaluator then constitutes a task, after which semantically near-duplicate tasks are removed. Together, environment-grounded synthesis and file-backed verification produce a scalable pool of verifiable tasks shared by SFT trajectory collection and online RL. Data infrastructure details are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh:
我们把评估综合的指令建议脱钩。 一旦一项指令建议被接受,其指令和成功条件被冻结,并交给独立的评估机构,由该机构汇编相应的核查逻辑。 方案可观测条件主要通过基于规则的对VM文件和命令行状态的检查来评价,而无法在方案上可靠恢复的视觉条件则通过基于VLM的评价来处理.
指令和评估人员在编审中另行审定. 检查指令的可达性、无矛盾性、现实性和充分的核查条件,而评估人员必须汇编并给予初始状态零奖励。 在可能的情况下,将修复无效的评估人员。 每一份经过验证的指令和评估师就构成一项任务,然后将大量几乎重复的任务删除。 以环境为基础的合成和以文件为基础的核查共同产生一系列可扩展的任务,这些任务由SFT轨迹收集和在线RL共同承担。 数据基础设施详情见附录B。

blocks.en: 3.3 Training Paradigm
blocks.zh: 3.3 培训范式

blocks.en: 3.3.1 SFT Cold Start
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 资助恐怖主义 冷启动

blocks.en:
Most open-source CUAs used as base models have previously been trained primarily for GUI-only interaction. They may possess visual understanding, coordinate grounding, and low-level control, but have not learned the new decision boundary created when code execution becomes an equally valid action. Merely adding a code tool expands the action space without supplying a routing prior for when to remain in the GUI, when to switch to code, and when to return to the interface for verification; it can even disrupt already learned GUI behavior. SFT therefore serves as a cold start in our pipeline: it establishes the action semantics of the unified tool schema and distills from teacher trajectories a coarse but usable GUI/code routing policy.
We collect SFT trajectories on tasks produced by the data infrastructure described in Section 3.2 , using Claude Sonnet 4.6 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) as the teacher model with both Computer Use and Bash Tool enabled. The resulting trajectories are then postprocessed and normalized into the OS-Helix action schema.
Each trajectory is scored by its evaluator, using the teacher model itself when visual judgment is required, and the resulting score serves as the primary signal for rejection sampling. We further apply a filtering pipeline to remove malformed tool calls, schema-mismatched actions, and trajectories that fail evaluator or quality checks, yielding a set of high-quality SFT samples. Training hyperparameters and data-mixture details are provided in Appendix C.1 .
blocks.zh:
大多数作为基础模型的开源CUA以前主要为GUI唯一的交互而训练. 他们可能拥有视觉理解,协调地平线,以及低级控制,但是在代码执行成为同样有效的行动时,还没有学会新的决定边界. 仅仅添加一个代码工具就可以扩展动作空间,而不会提供在GUI中停留的时间,切换代码的时间,以及返回界面进行校验的时间之前的路由;它甚至可以打乱已经学到的GUI行为. 因此,SFT在我们的管道中是一个冷酷的起步:它确立了统一工具计划的行动语义和从教师轨迹中提取的精液,是一种粗糙而可使用的GUI/代码路由政策。
我们收集了由第3.2节所描述的数据基础设施产生任务的SFT轨迹,使用克洛德·索内特4.6(Anthropic,2026年)作为教师模型,同时启用了计算机使用和Bash工具. 由此产生的轨迹随后被后处理并正常化为OS-Helix动作计划.
每个轨迹都由其评价员打分,在需要视觉判断时使用教师模型本身,由此得到的分数作为拒绝取样的主要信号. 我们进一步应用过滤管道来去除错误的工具调用,图案相匹配的动作,以及故障评估或质量检查的轨迹,产生一套高质量的SFT样本. 培训超参数和数据混合细节见附录C.1。

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Agentic RL with Step-Balanced GSPO
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 带有分级普惠制O的代理RL

blocks.en: We first build a cross-node environment management system that monitors and manages over one hundred Ubuntu sandbox environments across multiple standalone machines. The system exposes a unified port to the training side and internally dispatches requests to the environments. We then perform online RL on carefully filtered generated tasks with rule-based evaluators only, further improving model performance. Each rollout interacts with a live desktop environment, and the paired evaluator score serves as the sole outcome reward signal. If an assistant turn contains an unparsable tool call or any other invalid action-format error, that assistant response is isolated as an invalid sample and assigned a reward of 0 0 , even if the remaining trajectory could receive a positive evaluator score.
blocks.zh: 我们首先建立一个跨节点环境管理系统,通过多个独立的机器来监测和管理100多个Ubuntu沙盒环境。 该系统向训练方暴露出统一的港口,并在内部向环境发送请求. 然后,我们只与基于规则的评价人员进行经过仔细过滤的生成任务的在线RL,进一步改善了模型性能。 每次推出都与一个活的桌面环境互动,配对的评价分数是唯一的结果奖励信号. 如果一个助手转弯包含一个无法解析的工具调用或任何其他无效的动作格式出错,则该助手的响应被隔离为无效样本并分配了0.0的奖励,即使剩下的轨迹可以获得正评价分.

blocks.en:
We use three efficiency mechanisms to make online RL feasible under costly desktop interaction.
First, we adopt an asynchronous RL pipeline that allows the rollout policy to lag behind the latest policy by at most one version, enabling environment interaction and policy optimization to run in parallel.
Second, we maintain per-task success-rate estimates and bias sampling toward tasks near the current capability frontier, down-weighting tasks that are already too easy or remain too difficult.
Third, we apply bounded sliding-window visual-context segmentation to control context length and sample growth. Rollouts are split into segments and each segment can contain multiple assistant actions that contribute to loss.
We apply the same sliding-window segmentation logic during rollout inference to maintain consistency between training and inference.
blocks.zh:
我们利用三种效率机制,在昂贵的桌面互动下,使在线RL可行.
首先,我们采用一个同步的RL管道,使推出政策最多能有一个版本落后于最新政策,从而能够同时进行环境互动和政策优化。
第二,我们维持每个任务的成功率估计和偏向于当前能力前沿附近的任务、已经太容易或仍然太困难的减重任务。
第三,我们采用有边框的滑动窗口视觉-文字分解来控制上下文长度和样本生长. 推出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出
我们在推开推论时采用同样的滑窗分解逻辑,以保持培训和推论的一致性。

blocks.en:
In our preliminary RL experiments, standard GSPO exhibited a systematic drift toward code-intensive behavior as shown in Figure 4 . Specifically, as training progresses, the model increasingly favors code-related actions, ultimately resulting in a slight performance degradation relative to the initial SFT checkpoint.
Within a mixed GUI/code training sample, a code action typically contains substantially more assistant tokens than a GUI click or keystroke.
Standard GSPO averages token-level log-importance weights over all valid assistant tokens in the sample. Thus, even when a long code action constitutes only one of several GUI and code steps, it can dominate both the sample-level importance ratio and the clipping decision.
This motivates an aggregation in which the weight assigned to each action step in the sample-level log-ratio is no longer determined by its token count.
blocks.zh:
在我们的初步RL实验中,标准普惠制O表现出系统性地向密码密集行为转变,如图4所示。 具体而言,随着培训的进展,该模式越来越倾向于与代码有关的行动,最终导致与最初的SFT检查站相比,性能略有下降.
在混合的GUI/代码培训样本中,一个代码动作通常包含比GUI点击或按键键要多得多的辅助符号.
标准普惠制O对样本中所有有效辅助标志的平均符号级日志进口权重. 因此,即使一个长代码动作仅构成几个GUI和代码步骤之一,它也可以主导样本级的重要性比和剪接决定.
这激励了一个汇总,在样本级对数中,分配给每个动作步骤的权重不再由其符号数决定。

blocks.en: Step-balanced GSPO modifies only the aggregation of the sample-level ratio. For training sample i i , let a i , k a_{i,k} be the set of assistant-token positions that contribute to the loss for action step k k , and let τ i , k \tau_{i,k} denote its action type. Define the token-level importance weight w i , t ​ ( θ ) = π θ ​ ( y i , t ∣ h i , t ) / π old ​ ( y i , t ∣ h i , t ) w_{i,t}(\theta)=\pi_{\theta}(y_{i,t}\mid h_{i,t})/\pi_{\mathrm{old}}(y_{i,t}\mid h_{i,t}) and its log-importance weight δ i , t = log ⁡ w i , t ​ ( θ ) \delta_{i,t}=\log w_{i,t}(\theta) . blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: Table 1: Main results of OS-Helix on OSWorld. ♣ marks results reproduced by us; other baseline results are sourced from the official leaderboard. OS contains system-level OS tasks; Office contains LibreOffice Calc, Impress, and Writer tasks; Daily contains Chrome, Thunderbird, and VLC tasks; Prof. contains GIMP and VS Code tasks; and Work. denotes Workflow tasks involving multiple applications.
blocks.zh: 表1:OS-Helix关于OSWorld的主要结果. 我们复制的QQ标记结果;其他基线结果来自官方领导板。 OS包含系统级OS任务;Office包含LibreOffice Calc,Impress,和Writer任务;Daily包含Chrome,雷鸟和VLC任务;Prof.包含GIMP和VS代码任务;和Work. 表示涉及多应用程序的工作流程任务.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Evaluation Benchmarks. Our evaluation centers on desktop environments, employing OSWorld 1 1 1 In this paper, “OSWorld” refers to “OSWorld-Verified”. ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2025 ) as our primary benchmark, which comprises 369 real-world tasks across five domains in an Ubuntu environment. Following common practice ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , we exclude the 8 Google Drive tasks, yielding a final set of 361 tasks. We report mean success rate as the primary metric.
Beyond the Ubuntu environment, we additionally report results on WindowsAgentArena ( Bonatti et al., 2024 ) to evaluate cross-platform transfer to Windows.
blocks.zh:
评价基准。 我们的评价以桌面环境为中心,采用OSWorld 1 1 1在本文中,“OSWorld”是指“OSWorld-Verifed”。 (Xie等, 2024; Xie等, 2025.)作为我们的首要基准,它包含在Ubuntu环境中跨越五个领域的369个现实世界任务。 按照惯例(Xie等,2024年),我们排除了Google Drive的8个任务,最终产生了361个任务. 我们报告说,成功率是主要衡量标准。
在Ubuntu环境之外,我们还额外报告了WindowsAgentArena(Bonatti等,2024年)的成果,以评估跨平台向Windows的传输.

blocks.en:
Models and Baselines. We instantiate OS-Helix from Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) .
For broader context, we also report representative agentic frameworks, general-purpose models, specialist models, and matched backbone baselines.
blocks.zh:
模型和基线。 我们即时将OS-Helix从Quen3.5-27B和Quen3.5-35B-A3B(Quen Team,2026a.
就更广泛的背景而言,我们还报告具有代表性的代理框架、通用模型、专家模型和匹配的骨干基线。

blocks.en:
Implementation Details. For task synthesis, we use Claude Sonnet 4.6 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) for the Exploration and Evaluator Agents, and GPT-5.5 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) for an independent quality review agent.
For SFT, we train for one epoch on 31K successful filtered desktop samples synthesized by our pipeline and 40K general-purpose multimodal samples spanning code, reasoning, and related domains.
For RL, we initialize from the dense OS-Helix-27B checkpoint and conduct a 1,000-step training run using rule-based evaluators as reward signals.
Complete data details are provided in Appendix B , while training details are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh:
执行细节。 作为任务合成,我们使用克洛德·索内特4.6(Anthropic, 2026年)进行勘探和评价代理,并使用GPT-5.5(OpenAI, 2026年)进行独立的质量审查代理.
就SFT而言,我们为31K成功过滤的桌面样本和40K通用多模式样本培训一个世纪,这些样本跨越编码、推理和相关领域。
对于RL,我们从密集的OS-Helix-27B检查点初始化,并使用基于规则的评价员作为奖励信号进行1000步训练.
完整的数据详情见附录B,培训详情见附录C。

blocks.en: Unless otherwise specified, each evaluation episode is capped at 50 interaction steps and retains up to 8 historical screenshots (resolution 1504x832) together with the full textual interaction history. All reproduced baseline results are evaluated using the same harness and environment configuration.
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,每集评价以50个互动步骤封顶,并保留了最多8个历史截图(第1504x832号决议)以及完整的文字互动历史. 所有重复的基线结果都使用同样的手段和环境配置加以评价。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 2: Main results of OS-Helix on WindowsAgentArena. ♣ marks the baseline reproduced by us. All entries use a 50-step budget and a hybrid action space.
blocks.zh: 表2:OS-Helix在WindowsAgentarena上的主要结果. 我们所复制的基线。 所有条目都使用50步预算和混合行动空间.

blocks.en:
Table 1 shows that hybrid-policy training, rather than code-tool availability alone, yields substantial gains under matched-backbone comparisons. OS-Helix-27B and OS-Helix-35B-A3B improve over their corresponding Hybrid baselines by 16.25 and 14.43 absolute points, respectively. The largest gains occur in Office (+33.3 and +29.1 points) and Work. (+16.0 and +14.1 points). Office covers Calc, Impress, and Writer, where tasks often combine visually grounded interaction with rendered document states and precise transformations of structured artifacts. The Work. category comprises multi-application tasks that require task-relevant information to be handed off across applications and action modalities.
These interpretations are consistent with the agent behavior study and representative trajectory audit in Appendix F .
blocks.zh:
表1显示,混合政策培训,而不是单凭代码工具的可用性,在配套骨干比较下可产生很大收益。 OS-Helix-27B和OS-Helix-35B-A3B比相应的混合基线分别提高了16.25和14.43的绝对点. 最大的收益来自Office(+33.3和+29.1分)和Work.(+16.0和+14.1分)。 办公室负责Calc、Impress和Writer,其中的任务往往将视网膜互动与制成的文件状态和结构化文物的精确转换结合起来。 " 工作 " 类别包括多种应用任务,需要通过应用程序和行动模式传递与任务有关的信息。
这些解释与附录F中的代理人行为研究和代表性轨迹审计一致.

blocks.en: Starting from the SFT policy, OS-Helix-27B-RL further raises the average success rate from 62.75% to 66.44%. Its incremental gains are concentrated in Professional (+23.10 points), OS (+7.61 points), and Daily (+6.69 points), whereas Office and Work. do not improve further over their already strong SFT results. This profile shows that RL provides additional gains in specific task domains rather than a uniform increase across the benchmark. The paired-bootstrap analysis of the aggregate difference is reported in Table 16 .
blocks.zh: 从SFT政策开始,OS-Helix-27B-RL进一步将平均成功率从62.75%提高到66.44%. 其递增收益主要集中在专业(+23.10分),OS(+7.61分)和Daily(+6.69分),而Office and Work(Office and Work)。 与其已经强劲的SFT结果相比,没有进一步改进。 这一概况表明,RL在特定任务领域提供了额外收益,而不是整个基准的统一增加。 表16报告了对总差异的配对-波茨图分析。

blocks.en:
In broader, non-controlled comparisons, OS-Helix-27B-RL is competitive with GPT-5-based agentic frameworks such as Agent-S3 ( Gonzalez-Pumariega et al., 2025 ) and OS-Symphony ( Yang et al., 2026a ) , while newer and substantially larger general models remain stronger overall.
Table 2 further shows that the gains transfer to WindowsAgentArena, where OS-Helix-27B-RL improves over the Qwen3.5-27B GUI baseline by 23.05 points. This provides evidence of cross-platform transfer on WindowsAgentArena, with detailed results deferred to Appendix D.1 . Notably, the RL checkpoint also exhibits a larger improvement over the SFT checkpoint on WAA, suggesting that our online RL training further enhances the model’s generalization capability.
blocks.zh:
在更广泛的非控制比较中,OS-Helix-27B-RL与基于GPT-5的代理框架,如Agent-S3(Gonzalez-Pumariega等,2025年)和OS-Symphony(Yang等,2026年a)具有竞争力,而较新的和大得多的一般模型总体上仍然更强.
表2还表明,向WindowsAgentArena的增益转移,OS-Helix-27B-RL比Quen3.5-27B GUI基线提高23.05分. 这为WindowsAgentArena上的跨平台传输提供了证据,详细结果被推迟到附录D.1. 值得注意的是,RL检查站也比WAA上的SFT检查站有了更大的改进,这表明我们的在线RL培训会进一步提高模型的通俗化能力.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3 读取研究

blocks.en:
We conduct three groups of ablations: data robustness, training-stage and RL-objective attribution, and the unified GUI/code paradigm.
Unless otherwise specified, all variants use Qwen3.5-27B and are evaluated on OSWorld with the same harness configuration as the main experiments.
blocks.zh:
我们进行三组模拟:数据稳健性、培训阶段和RL目标归属以及统一的GUI/代码范式。
除非另有说明,所有变体都使用Quen3.5-27B,并在OSWorld上以与主要实验相同的被带配置来评价.

blocks.en:
Data robustness ablation. Table 3 tests whether the SFT gains require a strong trajectory teacher or data from OSWorld-related application domains. Panel (a) compares Kimi K2.5 ( Team et al., 2026b ) and Claude Sonnet 4.6 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) trajectories collected from the same 800 synthesized tasks. Panel (b) removes all samples from the nine OSWorld application domains, reducing the desktop SFT set from approximately 31K to 17K samples.
Both teacher-derived datasets outperform the unadapted Hybrid backbone, while the stronger teacher performs better.
Removing the nine related application domains shifts success from 62.75% to 62.31%. The retained performance after domain removal is consistent with capabilities that transfer beyond the evaluated application domains.
blocks.zh:
数据稳健性衰竭. 表3测试SFT收益需要强轨老师还是来自OSWorld相关应用域的数据. (a) 比较 Kimi K2.5 (Team等, 2026b)和克洛德·索内特 4.6 (Anthropic, 2026) 从同800个综合任务中收集出轨迹. 小组(b)从9个OSWorld应用域取出所有样本,将桌面SFT集从大约31K个样本减少到17K个样本.
两个师生数据集都优于未适应的混合骨干,而更强的教师表现更好.
删除9个相关应用域后,成功率从62.75%降至62.31%。 域去除后的保留性能与超出被评价应用域的转移能力相符合.

blocks.en: Table 3: Data robustness ablations.
blocks.zh: 表3:数据稳健度。

blocks.en: Table 4: Training-stage and RL algorithm ablations. Act. reports the fraction of actions assigned to code execution.
blocks.zh: 表4:培训阶段和RL算法模拟。 Act. 报告指定用于代码执行的行动的一小部分.

blocks.en:
Training-stage and algorithm ablation. Table 4 separates SFT, RL, and the RL objective. Panel (a) shows that SFT provides the main improvement over the unadapted Hybrid policy, RL alone changes little (+1.70 points), and applying RL after SFT yields the highest success rate of 66.44%.
Panel (b) isolates the RL objective under the same SFT initialization, data, sampling strategy, reward signal, and optimization budget. Standard GSPO lowers success to 60.47% and increases the code-action rate from 27.9% under the SFT policy to 40.0%, whereas Step-balanced GSPO raises success while maintaining a 26.1% code-action rate close to the SFT policy.
Together, these results suggest that action-step balancing improves evaluated performance while keeping the GUI/code action balance close to the SFT policy rather than drifting toward code-heavy behavior.
blocks.zh:
训练阶段和算法衰竭。 表4将SFT、RL和RL目标分开。 小组(a)显示,SFT比未适应的混合政策提供了主要改进,单是RL变化不大(+1.70分),在SFT取得66.44%的最高成功率后适用RL。
(b) 在相同的SFT初始化、数据、取样战略、奖励信号和优化预算下,将RL目标隔离开来。 标准普惠制O将成功率降至60.47%,并将守则行动率从SFT政策下的27.9%提高到40.0%,而步平制普惠制O提高了成功率,同时保持接近SFT政策的26.1%的守则行动率.
这些结果共同表明,行动步骤的平衡可以改善评估的业绩,同时使GUI/代码行动平衡接近SFT政策,而不是转向代码重的行为。

blocks.en: Table 5: Unified GUI/Code Paradigm ablations. Acc. denotes whether code execution access is enabled at inference; Act. reports the fraction of actions assigned to code execution.
blocks.zh: 表5:统一图形用户界面/代码参数。 Acc. 表示在推断时是否允许代码执行访问; Act. 报告指定用于代码执行的行动的一小部分.

blocks.en:
Unified GUI/code paradigm ablation. Table 5 disentangles code-tool availability from learned coordination. Panel (a) evaluates a fixed OS-Helix-27B checkpoint with and without code access. Panel (b) holds the backbone, SFT configuration, 10K-sample budget, and Hybrid evaluation harness fixed, changing only whether the SFT trajectories are GUI-only or hybrid GUI/code.
Disabling code for the same policy still yields 52.13% success; enabling it adds 10.62 points, demonstrating retained GUI competence and code complementarity.
With inference-time code access and the 10K-sample budget fixed, hybrid SFT adds 3.05 points over GUI-only SFT, indicating that training on hybrid trajectories enables a more effective use of shared GUI/code actions rather than relying on GUI-only supervision to generalize to code actions at inference.
blocks.zh:
统一GUI/代码范式缩写. 表5 将代码工具的可用性与学到的协调工作脱钩。 (a) 小组评价一个固定的OS-Helix-27B检查站,无论有无密码。 面板 (b) 持有主干,SFT配置,10K-样本预算,并固定混合评价取用,仅会改变SFT轨迹是只使用GUI还是混合GUI/代码.
同一政策的禁用代码仍然有52.13%的成功率;允许它增加10.62分,表明保留了GUI的能力和代码的互补性。
在推论时间代码访问和10K-样本预算固定的情况下,Mixy SFT比GUI仅限SFT增加了3.05分,表明混合轨迹培训可以更有效地使用共享的GUI/代码动作,而不是依靠GUI仅限监督来概括在推论时的代码动作.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: Accuracy versus efficiency. In Figure 3 , evaluator scores above 0.5 are counted as successes and scores below 0.5 as failures. Panel (a) reports mean interaction steps. All tasks and Own successes use each run’s complete and successful task sets, respectively, whereas Joint successes and Joint failures retain only shared tasks on which all three policies have the same binary outcome, controlling for task-composition differences. Panel (b) reports cumulative Success@ K K on OSWorld. Across the full set, successful episodes, and outcome-matched subsets, OS-Helix-27B uses fewer interactions while covering more successes under small step budgets. Learned modality routing therefore improves both execution efficiency and task coverage, an effect not reproduced by enabling code only at inference time.
blocks.zh: 准确性与效率. 在图3中,评价员的分数高于0.5,被计算为成功,而低于0.5的分数被计算为失败。 (a) 报告是指互动步骤。 所有任务和自身成功分别使用每个运行的完整和成功的任务组合,而联合成功和联合失败只保留所有三项政策都具有相同二进制结果的共享任务,控制任务组合差异。 (b) 小组在OSWorld上报告累积成功情况。 在整个集、成功事件和结果匹配子集中,OS-Helix-27B使用较少的互动,同时在小步骤预算中涵盖更多的成功。 因此,学习方式的路由既能提高执行效率,又能提高任务涵盖范围,而这种效果并不是只在推断时才允许使用代码。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Execution efficiency on OSWorld.
blocks.zh: 图3:OSWorld的执行效率。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Training dynamics, scaling, and coverage analysis.
blocks.zh: 图4:培训动态、规模和覆盖面分析。

blocks.en:
Why step balance matters. Panel (a) of Figure 4 uses the fraction of actions invoking code at each online RL update as a behavioral diagnostic. Under the same training setup, standard GSPO progressively drifts toward code-intensive behavior, whereas Step-balanced GSPO remains lower and more stable over the shared observed horizon.
Panel (b) reports repeated-sampling coverage. Compared with the SFT policy, OS-Helix-27B-RL improves Pass@1 from 62.75% to 66.44% (+3.69 points) and Pass@3 from 70.88% to 76.44% (+5.56 points), with the latter supported by a paired-bootstrap confidence interval of 95% [2.24,8.97].
The larger gain under Pass@3 indicates that RL does more than strengthen a single preferred trajectory and increases the probability of discovering distinct successful trajectories across independent attempts.
blocks.zh:
为什么步骤平衡很重要。 图4中的(a)面板将每个在线RL更新时引用代码的动作分部分用作行为诊断. 在同一培训安排下,标准普惠制O逐渐转向守则密集型行为,而步调平衡的普惠制O在共同观察到的地平线上仍然较低和更稳定。
(b) 小组报告重复抽样。 与SFT政策相比,OS-Helix-27B-RL将Pass@1从62.75%提升至66.44%(+3.69分)和Pass@3从70.88%提升至76.44%(+5.56分),后者辅以95%的对接-bootstrap置信间隔[2.24,8.97].
Pass@3下的较大收益表明,RL所做的不仅仅是加强单一的首选轨迹,还增加了发现不同成功的轨迹跨出独立尝试的概率.

blocks.en:
Training scaling and data distributions. Panels (c)–(f) of Figure 4 further examine the performance scaling and instruction distributions. Panel (c) reports success for the Work. category and the overall average across checkpoints from the first SFT epoch. Panel (d) holds the desktop data fixed and varies the fraction of the 40K general-purpose multimodal pool from 0% to 100%.
Both sets of curves improve overall as the supervision grows, indicating complementary contributions from hybrid trajectories and general-purpose data.
Panels (e)–(f) show kernel-density estimates of these per-task statistics. We encode each instruction with text-embedding-3-large ( OpenAI, 2024 ) , L2-normalize the embedding, and compute cosine similarity by vector dot product.
The cross-corpus similarity to OSWorld is comparable to OSWorld’s internal-instruction similarity, indicating limited instruction-level overlap.
Together with domain-removal ablation in Table 3 , this provides complementary evidence against direct instruction overlap or reliance on data from the evaluated domains.
Meanwhile, the synthesized corpus exhibits a higher but still broadly spread internal-similarity distribution, suggesting that it captures shared, transferable desktop-task structure rather than collapsing to a narrow instruction template family.
blocks.zh:
培训规模和数据分布。 图4的(c)-(f)小组进一步审查了业绩衡量和指示分布情况。 (c) 小组报告工作取得成功。 从第一个SFT时代起跨检查站的总平均数。 (d)面板将桌面数据固定,并将40K通用多式集合中的比例从0%到100%不等。
这两套曲线随着监督的扩大而总体得到改进,表明混合轨道和通用数据提供了互补的贡献。
小组(e)-(f)显示这些每个任务统计的内核密度估计数。 我们用文本嵌入-3-大(OpenAI, 2024)编码每个指令, L2 规范嵌入, 并按照矢量点产品计算出同心素相似性.
与OSWorld的跨公司相似性可与OSWorld的内部指令相似性相媲美,表明教学层次的重叠程度有限.
加上表3中的域迁移减少,这为直接指令重叠或依赖评价领域的数据提供了补充证据。
同时,综合体显示出较高但仍然广泛分布的内部同物分布,表明它能捕捉共享的可转移的桌面任务结构,而不是倒向狭义的指令模板家族。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We present OS-Helix, a native hybrid computer-using agent trained end-to-end through scalable executable desktop task synthesis, hybrid SFT, and Step-balanced GSPO online RL, designed to natively coordinate heterogeneous GUI and code actions within a single policy.
On OSWorld-Verified, OS-Helix-27B and OS-Helix-35B-A3B achieve relative improvements of 35.0% and 33.7% over their matched Qwen3.5 hybrid baselines, while OS-Helix-27B-RL further improves by 42.9% to reach 66.44% success. OS-Helix-27B-RL also transfers to WindowsAgentArena with 63.87% success, surpassing GPT-5-based framework methods on both benchmarks.
Ablations and behavioral analyses show that SFT provides the main gain, hybrid supervision outperforms GUI-only supervision at a fixed scale, and learned routing improves both execution efficiency and task coverage beyond code access alone.
Under matched RL settings, Step-balanced GSPO outperforms standard GSPO and mitigates its drift toward code-intensive behavior, while RL increases Pass@3 from 70.88% to 76.44%, indicating broader discovery of successful trajectories across independent attempts.
These findings establish native GUI/code coordination as a learnable hybrid paradigm and provide a reproducible foundation for further research on hybrid computer-using agents.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍OS-Helix,一种通过可扩展可执行桌面任务合成、混合SFT和Step-均衡的普惠制O在线RL培训的本地混合计算机使用代理端到端,旨在本地协调单一政策范围内的各种GUI和代码行动。
在OSWorld-Verification上,OS-Helix-27B和OS-Helix-35B-A3B比相匹配的Quen3.5混合基线实现相对改善35.0%和33.7%,而OS-Helix-27B-RL则进一步提高了42.9%,达到了66.44%的成功率. OS-Helix-27B-RL也以63.87%的成功率转会到WindowsAgentarena,超过了基于GPT-5的基于两个基准的框架方法.
分解和行为分析显示,SFT提供主要的增益,混合监督在固定尺度上优于GUI只监督,所学的路由在代码访问之外提高了执行效率和任务覆盖度.
在匹配的 RL 设置下,步态平衡的普惠制O比标准普惠制O的绩效要好,并减轻其向代码密集行为的飘移,而RL将Pass@3从70.88%提升到76.44%,表明在独立尝试中发现的成功轨迹范围更广。
这些发现将本土的GUI/代码协调确立为可学习的混合模式,并为关于混合计算机使用剂的进一步研究提供可复制的基础.

blocks.en: AI Use Statement
blocks.zh: AI 使用语句

blocks.en: In the preparation of this manuscript, we utilized LLMs to generate synthetic datasets, to refine the writing (including grammar and spelling corrections), to draft sections of the paper, and to assist with the preliminary derivation of mathematical formulas in Appendix E . The authors reviewed and take responsibility for the research design, experiments, analysis, claims, and final presentation.
blocks.zh: 在编写这份手稿时,我们利用LLMs生成了合成数据集,完善了作文(包括语法和拼音校正),起草了论文的章节,并协助初步推导出附录E中的数学公式. 作者审查并负责研究设计、实验、分析、索赔和最后陈述。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work does not involve human-subject studies or the collection of private data from real users. We study training methods for general-purpose computer-using agents, and conduct all trajectory collection, reinforcement learning, and evaluation in controlled, isolated Ubuntu virtual machines. The VMs use fixed application versions and a curated local file library, and are separated from personal host files and credentials. This setup reduces the risk that exploratory actions during research inadvertently modify host state or access unauthorized resources.
blocks.zh: 这项工作不涉及人类学科研究或从实际用户收集私人数据。 我们研究通用计算机使用剂的培训方法,并在受控制的、孤立的Ubuntu虚拟机中进行所有轨迹收集、强化学习和评价。 VMS使用固定的应用程序版本和一个被整理的本地文件库,并与个人主机文件和证书相分离. 这种设置降低了研究期间探索性行动无意地修改主办国或访问未经授权的资源的风险.

blocks.en: Although the experiments themselves present no substantial direct ethical risk, deploying agents with combined GUI interaction and code execution on real devices raises important safety and privacy concerns. Such agents can continuously observe screen content, modify local files, and execute Python or Bash, and may therefore encounter personally identifiable information, confidential documents, or authentication credentials. They may also be exposed to prompt injection through interface content or external files. Code actions further increase the potential impact of erroneous behavior or malicious workflows. The isolated experimental setting used in this work does not resolve these deployment-time risks.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些实验本身没有带来实质性的直接道德风险,但部署具有GUI互动和在实际设备上执行代码的综合作用的剂引起了重要的安全和隐私问题。 这类代理可以不断观察屏幕内容,修改本地文件,并执行Python或Bash,因此可能遇到个人可识别的信息,机密文件,或认证证书. 他们也可能通过界面内容或外部文件被迅速注射. 代码动作进一步增加了错误行为或恶意工作流程的潜在影响. 在这项工作中使用的孤立试验环境无法解决这些部署时间的风险。

blocks.en:
Real-world deployment should follow least-privilege and safety-by-design principles. These include granular permissions over applications, directories, networks, and code execution; explicit human confirmation before irreversible, credential-bearing, or otherwise high-impact operations; runtime policy checks, sandboxed execution, audit logs, and post-action verification; and data minimization and sanitization for screenshots, trajectories, and tool outputs. Users should retain the ability to define and revoke the agent’s authority, with sensitive applications such as banking, private communication, and credential management inaccessible by default.
Because general-purpose automation is inherently dual use, future CUA research should advance capabilities together with systematic red teaming, interpretable action auditing, and reliable human takeover mechanisms.
blocks.zh:
现实世界的部署应遵循最低特权和逐一设计安全的原则。 其中包括对应用程序、目录、网络和代码执行的颗粒式许可;在不可逆转、具有证书或其他影响大的行动之前明确确认人;运行时间政策检查、沙箱执行、审计日志和行动后核查;以及尽量减少截图、轨迹和工具输出的数据并进行消毒。 用户应保留界定和取消代理机构权力的能力,并有银行、私人通讯和证书管理等敏感应用程序默认无法进入。
由于通用自动化本质上是双重用途,因此未来的CUA研究应当与系统的红色团队合作,可解释的行动审计,以及可靠的人类接管机制一起推进能力.

blocks.en: Appendix A Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: OS-Helix is an initial step toward native GUI/code hybrid computer use, with remaining limitations centered primarily on computational and API resource constraints.
blocks.zh: OS-Helix是本土GUI/代码混合计算机使用的起步,其余限制主要以计算和API资源限制为中心.

blocks.en: First, desktop environments are difficult to scale comprehensively: even an application–artifact desktop infrastructure spanning diverse applications cannot cover the full diversity of real user machines, private artifacts, application versions, and personalized configurations. Future work should further expand the application and artifact ecosystem and study broader randomization of system states and user configurations while preserving reproducibility.
blocks.zh: 首先,桌面环境难以全面扩展:即使是一个跨越不同应用程序的应用程序-艺术桌面基础设施,也无法涵盖真实用户机、私人文物、应用程序版本和个人化配置的全部多样性。 今后的工作应进一步扩大应用和人工生态系统,并研究更广泛的系统状态和用户配置的随机化,同时保持可复制性。

blocks.en:
Second, automatic verification remains imperfect. Unlike software engineering tasks, where gold final states can be obtained deterministically, automated CUA task synthesis under limited resources cannot reliably capture ground-truth terminal states—tasks may therefore be subject to feasibility risks, and the resulting evaluators carry intrinsic brittleness.
Concretely, rule-based evaluators reliably cover many file-backed tasks but require careful construction and often depend on specific application versions or export formats; more fundamentally, even when an agent’s execution is semantically near-correct, inconsistent strictness in file-attribute checks can reduce the score to zero. Rubric-based partial scoring, adopted in several recent works including ours, partially alleviates this issue but does not resolve it entirely.
VLM-based evaluators extend coverage to textual outputs and visual outcomes, yet may miss fine-grained discrepancies; more critically, due to their inherent brittleness, existing RL engineering practice typically excludes VLM-based scoring from the reward signal altogether, concentrating construction effort on rule-based evaluators—which in turn constrains the types and diversity of tasks that can be incorporated into training.
Future work should develop stronger evaluator-generation, repair, and validation pipelines, and systematically study cross-evaluator agreement as well as robustness to reward hacking.
blocks.zh:
第二,自动核查仍然不完善。 与软件工程任务不同,在软件工程任务中,黄金最终状态可以决定性地得到,在有限的资源下自动化的CUA任务合成不能可靠地捕捉地上真实的终端状态——因此任务可能面临可行性风险,由此产生的评估人员具有内在的脆性.
具体地说,基于规则的评价人员可靠地完成了许多文件支持的任务,但需要仔细构建,并且常常依赖于具体的应用版本或导出格式;更根本的是,即使代理执行的高度接近正确,但文件属性检查中的不一致的严格性可以将分数降低到零. 包括我国在内的一些近期著作中采用的以Rubric为基础的部分评分,部分缓解了这一问题,但并未完全解决问题。
以VLM为基础的评价人员将覆盖面扩大到文字产出和视觉结果,但可能忽略了细微的差别;更严重的是,由于其固有的脆性,现有的RL工程做法通常将基于VLM的评分完全排除在奖励信号之外,将建筑工作集中在以规则为基础的评价人员上,这反过来又限制了可纳入培训的任务的类型和多样性。
今后的工作应发展更强大的评价者生成、修理和验证管道,并系统地研究交叉评价者协议以及奖励黑客的稳健性。

blocks.en:
Third, our agentic RL experiments are subject to certain limitations imposed by available computational resources. RL training was conducted only on the dense 27B model with relatively conservative hyperparameter settings; the total number of training steps was likewise constrained, precluding a systematic investigation of the scaling behavior of agentic RL.
For OS-Helix-35B-A3B, despite its strong performance in SFT experiments, the Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture introduces non-trivial additional challenges in training-inference consistency and optimization stability during agentic RL, making it difficult to support this training pipeline reliably under current resource conditions.
We regard a more thorough exploration of RL training dynamics and scaling laws, together with a stable extension of Step-balanced GSPO to larger MoE computer-using agents, as an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh:
第三,我们的代理RL实验受到现有计算资源施加的某些限制. 只有密集的27B模式进行了高参数设置的RL培训;培训步骤的总数也受到了同样的限制,因此无法对代理RL的缩放行为进行系统调查。
对OS-Helix-35B-A3B来说,尽管在SFT实验中表现很强,但"专家混合"(MoE)架构在代理RL期间引入了培训-推导一致性和优化稳定性的非三角附加挑战,使得在当前资源条件下难以可靠地支持这一培训管道.
我们认为,更彻底地探索远程教育培训动态和扩展法律,以及将逐步平衡的普惠制业务稳步推广到更大的教育部计算机使用机构,是今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en:
Beyond scaling, we believe the community is now at an inflection point where recursive self-improvement (RSI) deserves serious consideration. As CUA models attain a meaningful level of general computer-use capability, the model itself can serve as its own teacher: rolling out interaction trajectories on existing tasks, providing the training signal for the next iteration, and progressively improving through this self-bootstrapping loop.
Rather than relying solely on human demonstration or externally curated data, such a paradigm allows the agent to continuously generate its own training trajectories with growing quality as capability improves and feed them back into subsequent training rounds. We view this self-evolving, teacher-free training paradigm as one of the most promising long-term directions for advancing CUA agents.
blocks.zh:
除了扩大规模之外,我们认为,社区现在处于一个倒退的地步,需要认真考虑自我改进。 随着CUA模型获得有意义的一般计算机使用能力,模型本身可以充当自己的老师:推出关于现有任务的交互轨迹,为下个迭代提供训练信号,并通过这个自启动回路来逐步改进.
这种范式不是仅仅依靠人类演示或外部整理的数据,而是使代理人能够随着能力的提高而不断生成质量不断提高的自身训练轨迹并反馈到随后的训练周期. 我们认为,这种自我发展、无师资培训模式是推动团结会代理人发展最有希望的长期方向之一。

blocks.en: Finally, many existing desktop benchmarks were originally designed for GUI-only agents, with task design, reference solutions, and evaluation functions all implicitly centered on visual interaction paths. Although their tasks can often be completed with hybrid strategies, existing evaluators may not capture every valid GUI/code solution. Furthermore, using success rate as the sole metric is overly coarse: it neither distinguishes whether the agent selected the more efficient modality nor captures potential safety risks inherent to hybrid execution, such as unintended side effects of code execution or inadvertent system-level operations.
blocks.zh: 最后,许多现有的桌面基准最初是专门为GUI代理设计,任务设计,参考解决方案,评价功能都隐含地以视觉交互路径为中心. 虽然他们的任务往往可以通过混合策略来完成,但现有的评估人员可能无法捕捉到每一个有效的GUI/代码解决方案. 此外,使用成功率作为唯一的衡量标准过于粗糙:它既不区分代理人是否选择了效率更高的模式,也不反映混合执行所固有的潜在安全风险,例如代码执行的意外副作用或无意的系统层面操作.

blocks.en:
A particularly promising complementary direction is the migration and adaptation of existing general-purpose agent benchmarks such as GDPval ( Patwardhan et al., 2026 ) and Agents’ Last Exam ( Sun et al., 2026b ) into GUI environments. These benchmarks are inherently designed around authentic artifact manipulation and complex reasoning tasks, and thus naturally encompass diverse environment states and authentic artifacts. Porting them into desktop GUI settings not only amortizes the high cost of designing tasks from scratch, but also enables a unified evaluation framework that simultaneously exercises GUI interaction, code execution, and their hybrid coordination, providing a more ecologically valid testbed for deeply probing the GUI/code hybrid-driving paradigm.
Future benchmarks should explicitly support hybrid computer use from the task-design stage onward, providing multi-path reference solutions and jointly evaluating terminal-state correctness, execution efficiency, modality-selection appropriateness, and safety, thereby offering a more comprehensive and equitable evaluation framework for next-generation hybrid agents.
blocks.zh:
一个特别有希望的补充方向是将现有的通用代理基准,如GDPval(Patwardhan等,2026年)和代理最后考试(Sun等,2026年b)迁移到GUI环境中。 这些基准本质上是围绕真实的文物操纵和复杂的推理任务来设计的,因此自然包含不同的环境状态和真实的文物. 把它们移植到桌面 GUI 设置中,不仅可以从零开始摊还高额的任务设计成本,还可以实现一个统一的评价框架,同时进行 GUI 交互,代码执行,及其混合协调,为深入挖掘 GUI / 代码混合驱动模式提供更生态有效的测试床.
今后的基准应明确支持从任务设计阶段开始的混合计算机使用,提供多路径参考解决方案并联合评价终端状态的正确性、执行效率、模式选择适当性和安全性,从而为下一代混合剂提供一个更全面和公平的评价框架。

blocks.en: Appendix B Data Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 数据细节

blocks.en: B.1 Task Synthesis Comparison
blocks.zh: B.1 任务综合比较

blocks.en: Table 6 compares recent CUA task- and environment-synthesis pipelines across five dimensions: task grounding, application scaling, authentic artifact integration, cross-application task support, and executable evaluation. The comparison is organized along the axis of synthesis coverage rather than data scale or maturity. The broader contribution of OS-Helix is to extend exploration-grounded task generation toward artifact-grounded executable desktop-state construction: the pipeline jointly addresses K/E/C grounding, application scaling, authentic artifact-backed state initialization, and executable rule-based evaluation within a single coherent framework. Concretely, an application–artifact compatibility graph organizes valid pairings of application configurations and supported artifact types or file formats, enabling reproducible initial states to be instantiated systematically. The evaluator pipeline verifies persistent terminal outcomes rather than constraining the action sequence, supporting diverse task objectives and evaluation criteria across application domains and providing the infrastructure for subsequent hybrid-policy training.
blocks.zh: 表6比较了最近的CUA任务与环境综合管道,涉及五个方面:任务定位、应用规模、真正的文物整合、跨应用任务支持以及可执行评价。 比较按照合成覆盖轴线而不是数据规模或成熟度进行。 OS-Helix的更广泛贡献是将基于勘探的任务生成扩展到基于文物的可执行桌面状态建设:管道联合处理K/E/C地平面,应用缩放,真实的由文物支撑的状态初始化,以及在单一连贯的框架内基于可执行规则的评价. 具体地说,一个应用程序-艺术相容图组织有效的配对应用程序配置,并支持文物类型或文件格式,使可复制的初始状态能够被系统化地即时化。 评价员的管道核查持续的终端结果,而不是限制行动顺序,支持不同的任务目标和评价标准,并为随后的混合政策培训提供基础设施。

blocks.en: Table 6: Comparison of recent CUA task- and environment-synthesis pipelines. Synthesis grounding distinguishes external knowledge or application priors (K), task-specific environment or file inspection before the final instruction is proposed (E), and cross-instance coverage or capability memory (C). Application scaling denotes support for adding and configuring applications beyond an inherited benchmark; real artifact scaling denotes authentic or realistic file-backed inputs; rule-based evaluators programmatically inspect terminal states. A green check denotes explicit support, a red cross denotes no explicit support, and an orange check denotes preliminary but not yet systematic support.
blocks.zh: 表6:海关总署近期任务与环境综合管道的比较。 综合地基区分了外部知识或应用程序前科(K),任务特定环境或文件检查后再提出最终指令(E),以及交叉内涵或能力内存(C). 应用程序缩放表示支持在继承基准之外添加和配置应用程序;真正的文物缩放表示真实或现实的文件支持投入;基于规则的评价人员在程序上检查终端状态。 绿色检查表示明确支持,红色十字表示没有明确支持,而橙色检查表示初步但尚未系统支持.

blocks.en: Cross-application task synthesis is currently realized as a limited prototype, reflected by the partial symbol in the table; extending this component into a larger and more systematically characterized collection remains an explicit direction for future work. Works such as Qwen-CUA and Qwen-UI-Agent have demonstrated more extensive coverage of long-horizon and cross-application workflows at scale, and those dimensions represent clear avenues for subsequent expansion of OS-Helix.
blocks.zh: 交叉应用任务综合目前作为一种有限的原型实现,反映在表中的部分符号上;将这一部分扩展为更大和更系统化的集合仍然是未来工作的明确方向. Quen-CUA和Quen-UI-Agent等作品已经展示了更广泛覆盖了规模的长视距和跨应用工作流程,而这些维度是之后OS-Helix扩展的明显途径.

blocks.en: B.2 Applications and Artifacts Details
blocks.zh: B.2 应用程序和工艺细节

blocks.en: Our complete desktop application inventory comprises 45 applications, consisting of 44 named desktop applications spanning diverse functional categories and one dedicated OS application for system-level operations. Table 7 enumerates all applications organized by functional category, Table 8 lists the artifact types and file formats covered by the pipeline, and Table 9 reports the primary sources of commonly used artifact pools.
blocks.zh: 我们的完整的桌面应用程序库存包括45个应用程序,包括44个命名的桌面应用程序,涉及不同的功能类别,以及一个用于系统一级业务的专用OS应用程序。 表7列出了按功能类别分类的所有应用,表8列出了管道覆盖的文物类型和文件格式,表9报告了常用文物池的主要来源。

blocks.en: Table 9 focuses on the major artifact pools consumed by the application–artifact sampler. Long-tail artifact types not individually itemized in the table are handled through lightweight alternatives including small curated example libraries, application-bundled demo assets, simple format conversions, and manually constructed seed files rather than dedicated large-scale collection efforts, reflecting practical constraints on human resource availability.
blocks.zh: 表9着重说明应用技术取样器所消耗的主要文物池。 表中未逐项列出的长尾文物类型,通过轻量级替代处理,包括小的被整理的示例库,应用程序捆绑的演示资产,简单的格式转换,以及手动构建的种子文件,而不是专门的大规模收集工作,反映了人力资源可用性的实际限制.

blocks.en: Table 7: Functional classification of all 45 applications in the Ubuntu desktop infrastructure.
blocks.zh: 表7:Ubuntu桌面基础设施所有45个应用程序的功能分类.

blocks.en: Table 8: File and artifact types covered by the complete inventory of 45 applications.
blocks.zh: 表8:45项申请的完整清单涵盖的档案和文物类型.

blocks.en: Table 9: Primary sources of the file library by file type. Public upstream sources are written in repository-style form, including GitHub and dataset repositories where applicable. When an upstream source contains more files than needed for local deployment, we randomly sample a subset from that source. File types outside this table are covered through lightweight collection from small example libraries, application demo assets, simple conversions, or manually constructed seed files rather than large-scale harvesting.
blocks.zh: 表9 按文件类型分列的文件库主要来源. 公共上游来源以寄存器形式写出,包括GitHub和适用的数据集寄存器. 当一个上游来源包含比本地部署所需的更多文件时,我们随机抽取该来源的一个子集. 本表外出的文件类型通过小示例库的轻量级收藏,应用程序演示资产,简单转换,或人工构造的种子文件来覆盖,而不是大规模收割.

blocks.en: B.3 Final State Materialization
blocks.zh: B.3 最终状态

blocks.en: Our everything-is-a-file abstraction treats the file system as a common inspection interface rather than as a restriction on where a task state must originate. A terminal condition may initially reside in a downloaded web page, an in-memory application state, an unsaved layout, or a persistent user artifact. We attempt to materialize the relevant condition into a VM-resident file representation whenever this can preserve the semantics needed for evaluation: a web state may be downloaded or serialized locally, an in-memory result may be exported, and an answer may be written to a structured or plain-text file. This externalization separates the location of a state from its verifiable representation and allows heterogeneous desktop objectives to share a common evaluation interface.
blocks.zh: 我们的一切文件抽象化将文件系统视为一个共同的检查界面,而不是对任务状态必须来自何处的限制. 一个终端条件最初可能居住在一个被下载的网页,一个内存应用状态,一个未保存的布局,或者一个持久的用户文物. 我们试图将相关条件变成一个VM-居民文件代表,只要这能够保存评价所需的语义:一个网络状态可能在当地被下载或被序列化,一个模拟结果可能导出,一个答案可能写在结构化或平白文字文件中. 这种外部化将状态的位置与其可核查的表示区分开来,并允许不同的桌面目标共享一个共同的评价界面.

blocks.en:
The materialization step is not uniformly lossless. Some conditions, such as exact document structure, metadata, or serialized application state, admit faithful programmatic inspection; others depend on rendered layout, canvas appearance, transient UI state, or content for which serialization does not preserve the relevant evidence. Evaluator selection therefore reflects an observability trade-off: rule-based checks are used when a deterministic file or command representation captures the required semantics, VLM-based checks are used when visual or otherwise non-serializable evidence is essential, and hybrid evaluators combine the two when they provide complementary evidence.
The resulting evaluator is agnostic to whether the agent reached the terminal condition through GUI actions, code execution, or their combination.
blocks.zh:
具体化步骤并非一律无所失. 一些条件,如准确的文档结构,元数据,或序列化的应用程序状态,承认忠实的程序检查;另一些条件则依赖于渲染的布局,画布外观,瞬态的UI状态,或序列化无法保存相关证据的内容. 因此,评价者选择反映了可观察性权衡:在确定文件或命令表述抓住所需语义时,采用基于规则的检查;在视觉证据或其他非序列性证据必不可少时,采用基于VLM的检查;在提供补充证据时,混合评价者将两者结合起来。
由此而来的评价者对代理人是否通过GUI动作,代码执行,或者它们的组合而达到终端条件是不可知的.

blocks.en: B.4 Instruction and Evaluator Synthesis Details
blocks.zh: B.4 指导和评价人员综合细节

blocks.en: The primary task-synthesis pipeline instantiates states through the application–artifact compatibility graph. The pipeline then follows a one-way information flow: application and artifact configurations determine the initialization context; the Exploration Agent produces a structured instruction proposal and textual success conditions; the independent Evaluator Agent compiles the frozen conditions into rule-based or visual checks; and each independently validated instruction-evaluator pair enters the task pool.
blocks.zh: 主任务合成管道即时处理通过应用程序 - 艺术相容图来表示 。 管道随后遵循单向信息流:应用和文物配置决定初始化背景;勘探代理公司制作结构化指令建议书和文本成功条件;独立评估代理公司将被冻结的条件汇编成有章可循的或可视的检查;每个独立验证的指令-评估对子进入任务池.

blocks.en:
For each application, we record a canonical name, version, supported artifact types and file formats, launch commands, and initialization templates, and use these fields to build the application–artifact compatibility graph. Each synthesis episode first restores a controlled VM snapshot and samples a primary application, then selects zero or more compatible artifacts through the graph according to the application’s initialization templates.
For every sampled pre-existing artifact, initialization creates a VM-resident, evaluator-only golden copy before task execution while leaving the original path as the active task target; this copy is bound to the task configuration and may serve as the expected reference in subsequent content or structural comparisons. The system then provides the Exploration Agent with application metadata, exact file paths, launch configuration, an application tutorial, global application memory, and an initial screenshot.
blocks.zh:
对于每个应用程序,我们都会记录一个冠名、版本、支持的文物类型和文件格式、发射命令和初始化模板,并利用这些字段来构建应用程序 - 艺术相容图。 每集合成会首先恢复受控的VM快照并取出主应用样本,再根据应用的初始化模板通过图表选择零相容或更相容的文物.
对于每一个被取样的已存在文物,初始化都会在任务执行前创建出一个VM-居民,评价者唯一的黄金拷贝,同时将原始路径作为活性任务目标;此拷贝被绑定在任务配置上,并可作为后续内容或结构比较中的预期参考. 系统然后向"探索代理"提供应用程序元数据,精确的文件路径,发射配置,一个应用程序教程,全球应用程序内存,以及初始截图.

blocks.en: The following partial PyCharm configuration illustrates how application metadata connects application initialization with artifact-library sampling.
blocks.zh: 以下部分的PyCharm配置说明了应用程序元数据如何将应用程序初始化与文物-图书馆采样联系起来.

blocks.en: The version field fixes the application version assumed by task synthesis, trajectory collection, and evaluator implementation, while type declares the artifact or project types that the application can directly consume. The two entries in commands are alternative initialization templates: the first launches an empty application, and the second launches the application with a sampled artifact. The position-aligned values in random are normalized into initialization probabilities; hence [10, 90] assigns approximately 10% probability to an empty PyCharm launch and 90% to a file- or project-backed launch. When the second template is selected, the system randomly samples an absolute file path whose type is compatible with type from the artifact library and substitutes it for PATH before executing the command. The related_app and related_type fields retain compatibility relations among applications and artifact types for selecting conventional companion applications and for the graph-guided cross-application prototype.
blocks.zh: 版本字段修正了任务合成、轨迹收集和评估实施所假设的应用程序版本,而类型则宣布应用程序可直接消耗的文物或项目类型。 命令中的两个条目是可替代的初始化模板:第一个推出一个空应用程序,第二个推出一个被采样出品的应用程序. 随机位置相通值常态化为初始化概率;因此[10,90]将大约10%的概率分配给空的PyCharm发射,90%分配给文件或项目支持的发射. 当选择了第二个模板时,系统在执行命令之前随机抽取一个绝对文件路径,其类型与来自文物库的类型相容并取而代之. 相關的_app和相關的_type字段保留了应用程序和文物类型之间的相容性关系来选择常规的相伴应用程序并用于图导的交叉应用原型.

blocks.en: This declarative configuration is what makes application scaling reproducible rather than a collection of ad hoc launch scripts. Adding an application requires specifying its version, launch procedures, supported artifact types, initialization probabilities, and optional relations to companion applications. The compatibility graph then filters valid application–artifact pairings before an episode is instantiated in a fixed VM, allowing new applications and artifact types to expand the executable state space while preserving initialization and sampling semantics.
blocks.zh: 这种宣示性配置是使得应用程序缩放可再出而并非是临时发射脚本的集合. 添加一个应用程序需要具体说明其版本,发射程序,支持的文物类型,初始化概率,以及与配套应用程序的可选关系. 相容图然后过滤一个插曲被即时化后的有效应用 - artifact 配对,允许新的应用和文物类型扩展可执行状态空间,同时保留初始化和采样语义.
